title: Influence of the type of bone substitute materials on the rates of bone regeneration in sinus lift grafting with lateral approach and delayed implant placement
authors: Papanchev G, Peev S, Georgiev T. Clinical Oral Implants Research. 2020 Oct;31:251-251.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “and Clinical Implications: In conclusion, we can say that sinus lift grafting with lateral approach can be used with equal success in different age groups and always leads to predictable and stable results over time. Xenogeneic bovine hydroxyapatite is a favourite when choosing a bone substitute material. The lack of a statistically significant difference in the volume of the newly formed bone between the 6th and 9th month gives grounds for earlier placement of dental implants reducing treatment time” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
